causebase_summary: Institute of Public Works Engineering Australasia (NSW Division) Ltd (branded on its website as IPWEA NSW & ACT) presents itself as a professional association and training provider for public works and local government engineering professionals in New South Wales and the Australian Capital Territory. The organisation’s website lists events, training courses, and an Advocacy & Policy stream; it advertises specific forums (Public Works AI Forum, 21 August 2026; Development Engineering Forum, 12–13 November 2026) and says it hosts technical events and workshops. It states it is a Registered Training Organisation (RTO 90174) and offers accredited and short courses, and that it provides NSW Government subsidised courses through Smart and Skilled (318282). The website invites membership and attendance at events and training. The ACNC AIS extract for 01/07/2022–30/06/2023 reports revenue of AUD 2,203,114 and total expenses of AUD 2,485,661 for the reporting period. The descriptions of activities and beneficiaries in this summary are drawn from the organisation’s website excerpts and its ACNC reporting.
